data.content:
* * *

## [I have yet to receive my order](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/650f5e49fbde4ff79b25cd83)

I have yet to receive my order, hasn’t even shipped after 7 days! You charged me but still waiting on the order. I wouldn’t mind you charge for shipping and it sucks!

Still waiting for it to arrive, now saying arriving Monday. So I have now been waiting 16 days for this item AND that was for paying for shipping! Worst service ever.

September 15, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Sep 26, 2023

Hi Denise,

Thank you for reaching out. We deeply apologize for the delay with your item. We are currently backed up with some orders but our team is working diligently to get these orders shipped out as soon as possible. Looking into this further, we see your pillow will arrive this Saturday. We appreciate your patience and again, are truly sorry for any inconvenience this has caused.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
